description: Read one public signed request by its id from the existing /labor/requests door, including the request's current resolution and existing next-action projection. This is a read, not a new request, a funding event or proof of completion. If a work packet has been linked, use funding_quote to read whether it is actually fundable. A missing, blocked or still-open request is not a promise of service.

requestId.description: The request.id returned by submit_request (e.g. REQ_...). Public read, no signature required.

name: request_status
title: Read the recorded need, its bridge result and what to do next
